messages:
maya liang: Heads-up — I want to run a small canary to change the max_concurrency soft cap for the burst path and enable queueing fallback for VIP customers only. Target window: 1h tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC.

liam choi: 👍 which feature flag key? and what's the canary audience percent?

maya liang: flag: `features.autoscale.max_concurrency.soft_cap_v2`
canary audience: `team_vip` (~3% of traffic, routed by tenant id). Not flipping hard cap, just soft cap from 48 -> 32 and enable `queueing_enabled: true` for that audience.

sara gonzalez: Can you paste the curl or the config patch so infra can validate? Also exec owner for rollback?

maya liang: sure — patch we'll apply via ff-service:

```
PATCH /flags/features.autoscale.max_concurrency.soft_cap_v2
{
  "value": {
    "soft_cap": 32,
    "queueing_enabled": true
  },
  "audience": "team_vip",
  "reason": "reduce per-gpu OOM risk during KV-heavy bursts"
}
```

Rollback plan: kevin will revert to previous value (48) and disable queueing if we see latency/regressions.

kevin park: I can own rollback. I'll be oncall this window. I'll also watch the auto-scale dashboard and token-level p95 latency. Link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/autoscale/overview?view=max_concurrency

devops-bot: @maya liang received patch request. Dry-run validation passed. Suggested rollout steps:
1) apply flag in staging for 30m
2) smoke test with smoke-suite (embedding/llm-chat)
3) apply to canary audience, validate logs and metrics for 15m
4) gradually increase to 5% if stable

liam choi: Quick checklist: set alert for p99 latency > 2s, error-rate spike > 0.5% (5m), and OOM events > 0 over 10m. Add a trace tag `ff:softcap_v2` so we can filter spans.

sara gonzalez: Also add a fallback policy: if p99 > 2s for >2 consecutive 5m windows, automatically roll back flag. Is that in the rollout policy matrix?

maya liang: Not automated yet — will open a rollback playbook entry. For tonight we do manual rollback with kevin owning. I'll add the quick-runbook in #incidents and pin it.

kevin park: I'll subscribe to the alerts and have an `ops` shell ready. If we need to revert:
```
curl -X POST https://ff-service.redwood.internal/api/flags/rollback -d '{"key":"features.autoscale.max_concurrency.soft_cap_v2","to_value":{"soft_cap":48,"queueing_enabled":false}}'
```

oncall-bot: Reminder — Scheduled maintenance window 22:00-23:00 UTC tonight for infra changes. Pager duty: kevin park.

maya liang: Thanks all. Plan: staging at 19:30 UTC, smoke for 30m, then canary at 22:00. I'll post updates here during the rollout. :thumbsup:
